system.story: One charged line that rallies an ally or rattles a foe - the warlord's every-turn hinge.

effect.after:
Action or maneuver, no Influence. Deliver a single charged line - choose one:

  • Rally an ally: clear a minor morale/fear condition, grant a saving throw, or steel them (temporary edge).
  • Rattle a foe: impose a bane, a minor social/morale debuff, or a taunt that pulls their attention to you.

Enhance (spend 1 Influence): hit an area (all allies or all foes in range), or upgrade to a stronger condition.
